page: Amazon Web Services i7ie.xlarge is a storage-optimized instance built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features an x86_64 architecture powered by an Intel Xeon 8559C processor running at 3.2 GHz. The instance provides 4 dedicated vCPUs, which correspond to 2 physical cores with hyper-threading, and a large 320 MB L3 cache. It is equipped with 32.0 GB of high-speed DDR5 memory operating at 6 GHz, translating to 8.0 GB of RAM per core.

A key feature of the i7ie.xlarge is its bundled local storage, offering 2500 GB of NVMe SSD capacity. It does not include any GPUs. For networking, the instance delivers a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. It does not include any complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Benchmark results show highly polarized performance. The instance achieves top-tier single-core performance, as evidenced by a Geekbench single-core score of 2314.0 and strong single-threaded compression and decompression speeds, such as 34.74 GB/sec for gzip. However, multi-core and memory bandwidth metrics are more modest, with stress-ng multi-core performance and large-block memory read bandwidth falling into the lower percentiles. Passmark CPU and memory scores sit in the average tier, alongside a Redis SET throughput of 6.09 million operations per second.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the i7ie.xlarge offers a dense combination of high-speed DDR5 memory and substantial local NVMe SSD storage relative to its 4 vCPU compute footprint. This makes it highly suitable for storage-heavy and memory-intensive workloads that benefit from strong single-threaded CPU performance but do not require massive multi-core scaling. Recommended workloads include relational and non-relational databases, caching layers, and localized data processing tasks.
